questionEnglish: How does India view the Kashmir issue in its relations with neighbors?

questionEnglish: What is the importance of the Commonwealth in India's foreign policy?

questionEnglish: Why did India not join the NATO pact?
questionOdia: ଭାରତ କାହିଁକି ନାଟୋ (NATO) ସନ୍ଧିରେ ଯୋଗ ଦେଇନଥିଲା?
